intuition: Rotting spreads one grid step per minute from all currently rotten oranges.

brute_force.approach: For each minute, repeatedly scan the whole grid and rot fresh oranges adjacent to rotten ones.

optimal.approach: Use multi-source BFS from all rotten oranges and measure the greatest distance needed to reach fresh ones.

edge_cases: No fresh oranges means zero minutes.
A fresh orange unreachable from every rotten orange makes the result -1.
